reason: The V1 stress contract used an 80/14/6 source target that is materially inconsistent with the authoritative FULL104 composition. No 100K stress execution has occurred, so this is corrected prospectively rather than post-hoc.

replacement_rule.full_scale: At n=4,553,407, source counts must equal the authoritative FULL104 counts exactly.
replacement_rule.stress_scale: For any other n, use deterministic Hamilton/largest-remainder apportionment of the authoritative FULL104 counts, summing exactly to n.
replacement_rule.cell_assignment: Assign apportioned source counts through a deterministic bijective permutation of global cell identity so source assignment is invariant to shard size/order and is not represented by contiguous cell ranges.

still_unresolved_before_100K.donor_size_structure: The current modulo donor assignment is an engineering placeholder and does not reproduce empirical donor-size imbalance.
still_unresolved_before_100K.source_operator_nesting: The current 42-level hashed operator assignment is an engineering placeholder and does not yet reproduce the authoritative source/operator nesting and support structure.

promotion_rule: 100K stress promotion is blocked until independent audit either qualifies donor/source/operator structure for the intended stress purpose or replaces the placeholders prospectively.
